name: claude-md-plugin
description: Node-agent tree plugin (v19). Each directory is an agent: its CLAUDE.md is the agent's prompt, its source code is the agent's tool set, and cohesive sub-domains become child agents to whom the parent delegates. v19 is an in-progress redesign; v18 workflows (/spec, /dev, /validate, /decompile, /bugfix, /impact, /inspect, /autodev) are pending teardown.
